{"test_cases": [
    {"id": "TC1", "title": "Positive Test Case for Password Length and Complexity", "type": "positive",
     "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page, current password is correct.",
     "steps": [
         "User enters a password that is 8 characters long and contains at least one digit.",
         "User confirms the password and clicks the 'Update Password' button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Password is updated successfully and user sees the message 'Password updated'.",
     "covers": ["AC1", "AC2", "AC3"]
     },
    {"id": "TC2", "title": "Negative Test Case for Password Length", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page, current password is correct.",
     "steps": [
         "User enters a password that is 65 characters long.",
         "User confirms the password and clicks the 'Update Password' button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Password update fails and user sees an error message.",
     "covers": ["AC1"]
     },
    {"id": "TC3", "title": "Negative Test Case for Password Complexity", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page, current password is correct.",
     "steps": [
         "User enters a password that does not contain any digits.",
         "User confirms the password and clicks the 'Update Password' button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Password update fails and user sees an error message.",
     "covers": ["AC2"]
     },
    {"id": "TC4", "title": "Negative Test Case for Password Same As Current", "type": "negative",
     "preconditions": "User is logged in and on the account page, current password is correct.",
     "steps": [
         "User enters the same password as the current password.",
         "User confirms the password and clicks the 'Update Password' button."
     ],
     "expected_result": "Password update fails and user sees an error message.",
     "covers": ["AC3"]
     }
]}
